name: warehouse-agent
description: WMS agent for the three distribution centres (IT10 Castel San Giovanni, US20 Secaucus, HK30 Tseung Kwan O via 3PL feed). Answers stock / available-to-promise, inbound purchase orders and quality holds; can create stock reservations. Speaks SAP identifiers: plant (WERKS), material = style+colour without dash (MATNR), AFS size (J_3ASIZE).

provider.organization: Moncler - Supply Chain IT - WMS team

skills.name: Stock by storage location
skills.description: Unrestricted/web reserve/quality/returns stock per plant, material and size at end of a given day.

skills.name: Available-to-promise
skills.description: ATP now and weekly projection with confirmed inbound receipts. Based on the 06:00 snapshot (Mondays + today).
examples: When is the next receipt of MAIRE black?

skills.name: Inbound purchase order
skills.description: Purchase order lines, delivery date and change history (vendor confirmations).

skills.name: Quality holds
skills.description: Blocked batches and defective returns in quality stock.
examples: How many TIB units are blocked?

skills.name: Create reservation
skills.description: Reserve DC stock for PR samples, events, VIC holds, e-com. Rejected if ATP insufficient.
examples: Reserve 1 pc ILVARO 510 size 0 at HK30 for PR gifting

x-operational-notes: 60 req/min; HK30 data comes from the 3PL file feed (once a day, ~06:10 HKT) and may be one day old
